children.name: Flagellaria collaris Wepfer & H.P.Linder
children.description: The native range of this species is Fiji. It grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Flagellaria gigantea Hook.f.
children.description: The native range of this species is Bismarck Arch. to SW. Pacific. It is a climber and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Flagellaria guineensis Schumach.
children.description: The native range of this species is Trop. & S. Africa, Madagascar, Mauritius, Sri Lanka. It is a climber and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.

children.name: Flagellaria indica L.
children.description: Flagellaria indica is a climbing plant found in many of the tropical and subtropical regions of the Old World, in India, Bangladesh, Southeast Asia, Polynesia, and Australia.

children.name: Flagellaria minor Blume ex Schult.f., 1830
children.description: Flagellaria minor Blume ex Schult.f., 1830 — a liliopsida species in the genus Flagellaria.

children.name: Flagellaria neocaledonica Schltr.
children.description: The native range of this species is Solomon Is. to New Caledonia. It is a climber and grows primarily in the wet tropical biome.
